topics.name: Topological and Geometric Relational Representation Learning
topics.summary: Graph models encode topology, direction, recurrence, and geometric relations for structured reasoning. Applications span biological networks, dynamical trajectories, and visual features, with transport-aware operators and asymmetric divergences improving representation fidelity and transfer.

topics.name: 3D Gaussian Scene Reconstruction and Neural Rendering
topics.summary: Gaussian scene models are extended with motion handling, semantic structure, cross-modal appearance, camera adaptation, and compact representations. Experiments cover novel-view synthesis, dynamic mapping, spectral rendering, and efficient deployment across varied viewpoints.

topics.name: Speech Representation and Multilingual Acoustic Modeling
topics.summary: Speech systems learn from limited labels, multilingual mixtures, acoustic targets, and long audio sequences. The studies improve recognition, synthesis, spoken question answering, prosody prediction, spatial hearing, and transfer across languages and recording conditions.

topics.name: Audio Coding and Speech-Driven Media Understanding
topics.summary: Adaptive audio models respond to packet loss, sampling-rate changes, and media context at inference time. Evaluations connect codec efficiency with acoustic quality, while multimodal systems use voice, language, and visual cues for engagement and narrative attribution.

topics.name: Dialogue Intent Modeling and Human-AI Interaction
topics.summary: Dialogue agents infer latent goals, social context, and pedagogical intent to choose responses or persuasion strategies. Controlled interaction studies also examine team structures, simulated social contact, and how model or persona settings affect cooperation and belief change.

topics.name: LLM Reasoning, Calibration, and Decoding
topics.summary: Language-model internals and decoding procedures are analyzed to estimate difficulty, confidence, and useful computation. Hidden-state signals, denoising trajectories, cache-aware serving, and adaptive verification improve reliability or reduce the cost of long-sequence generation.

topics.name: LLM Safety, Auditing, and Oversight
topics.summary: Safety research combines red-teaming, activation and weight inspection, runtime alarms, and permission-aware testing. Across multilingual prompts, deceptive behavior, refusal failures, and persistent attacks, the results show that static safeguards can be bypassed without monitoring model state and execution context.

topics.name: Alignment and Preference Learning for Language Models
topics.summary: Alignment methods model uncertain rankings, competing user objectives, explicit safety costs, and delegated-agent responsibilities. Preference elicitation, dual objectives, calibrated validation, and trace-level checks are used to preserve helpful behavior under inconsistent or incomplete supervision.

topics.name: Multi-Agent Deliberation and Collective Forecasting
topics.summary: Collective prediction studies vary communication topology, evidence partitioning, group size, and prompt context. Deliberation can improve accuracy when agents retain complementary information, but unrestricted exchange may correlate errors and collapse useful diversity.

topics.name: Scientific Agents and Research Infrastructure
topics.summary: Language-model agents combine literature retrieval, knowledge graphs, data discovery, reproducibility checks, and provenance-aware tooling for scientific workflows. Earth observation and computational research applications show the value of structured evidence and auditable intermediate steps.

topics.name: Agentic Software Engineering and Program Synthesis
topics.summary: Coding systems use search, compiler feedback, hierarchical decomposition, historical fixes, and explicit intermediate artifacts to generate or repair software. Benchmarks and repository studies emphasize executable evidence, maintainability, and broader solution coverage beyond surface-level code completion.

topics.name: Verification and Testing of Tool-Using Agents
topics.summary: Tool-using agents are evaluated through sandboxed safety tests, attack reproduction, causal plan repair, and feedback-driven iteration. These methods inspect intermediate execution traces and preserve validated plan regions when correcting failures or searching for hidden objectives.

topics.name: Robot Learning for Manipulation and VLA Control
topics.summary: Robot policies combine language, vision, proprioception, tactile prediction, synthetic interaction, and motor pretraining for manipulation. Real and simulated experiments target contact handling, task transfer, payload variation, and closed-loop action generation with less manual supervision.

topics.name: Robotic Mobility and Adaptive Control
topics.summary: Mobile robots use contact-aware planning, predictive control, disturbance adaptation, and world-model checks to navigate constrained terrain or changing dynamics. Demonstrations include quadrupeds, surface vehicles, offline control, and hardware-aware tracking under uncertain actuation.

topics.name: Aerial Robotics and UAV Autonomy
topics.summary: Aerial systems combine lightweight perception, differentiable or adaptive dynamics, thrust-vector control, and structured planning. Indoor and outdoor tests focus on real-time operation, agile interception, obstacle handling, and tracking despite coupled vehicle dynamics.

topics.name: Robot Policy Evaluation and Deployment
topics.summary: Robot-policy studies build repeatable hardware evaluation pipelines with synchronized execution, modular interfaces, logging, and reusable trial data. The emphasis is on measuring long-horizon behavior faithfully across simulation, learned policies, and physical platforms.

topics.name: Embodied Spatial Reasoning and Active Perception
topics.summary: Embodied agents select informative views and align language with routes, panoramas, coordinates, and evolving scene structure. Hindsight descriptions, camera control, search memory, and temporal grounding help agents reason under partial visual access.

topics.name: Human Motion, Interaction, and Articulated Bodies
topics.summary: Motion models generate long interactions, hand-object contact, character retargeting, and patient-specific articulated anatomy. Causal diffusion, contact cues, rig-aware tokens, and kinematic constraints support stable editing and transfer across bodies and behaviors.

topics.name: Medical Image Analysis and Segmentation
topics.summary: Clinical vision systems use anatomy-aware features, temporal context, multiscale fusion, semi-supervised learning, and region-level alignment for diagnosis and segmentation. Applications include cardiac, dental, reproductive, thoracic, and lesion imaging with limited labels or sparse views.

topics.name: Multimodal Clinical AI
topics.summary: Clinical models combine images with reports, retrieval, demographic or neuropsychological variables, and domain-specific supervision. Studies address traditional diagnosis, ultrasound reasoning, disease discrimination, imbalance, and patient-level validation rather than relying on generic visual features alone.

topics.name: Visual-Language Grounding and Video Evaluation
topics.summary: Vision-language systems are tested on region selection, open-vocabulary counting, long-video evidence search, and temporal grounding. Attention control, proposal calibration, question-driven frame retrieval, and dense domain benchmarks expose failures in fine-grained localization and extended context.

topics.name: Robust Vision-Language Models
topics.summary: Vision-language robustness studies cover corrupted medical images, license-plate recognition, clinical distribution shifts, misleading image text, and self-correction. Uncertainty estimates, representation interventions, and recovery mechanisms improve behavior on unfamiliar or adversarial inputs.

topics.name: Diffusion Models for Efficient and Controllable Generation
topics.summary: Diffusion and flow-based generators are accelerated with staged sampling, low-bit computation, timestep-aware training, and learned time allocation. Other systems add frequency, geometric, or cross-modal controls for faithful editing, restoration, and detail preservation.

topics.name: Compositional and Distribution-Aware Image Generation
topics.summary: Image generators are trained against concept composition, batch-level feature distributions, and multi-encoder similarity rather than isolated pixel targets. The resulting methods improve negation handling, visual variety, mode coverage, and transfer to unfamiliar concepts or modalities.

topics.name: Image Restoration and Task-Aware Reconstruction
topics.summary: Restoration models incorporate physical degradation, acquisition constraints, and downstream semantic checks for low-light, haze, low-dose CT, undersampled MRI, and satellite imagery. Evaluations prioritize retained anatomy, lesions, boundaries, landscape structure, and task accuracy alongside visual quality.

topics.name: 3D Geometry and Object Reconstruction
topics.summary: Image-based geometry systems infer depth, point maps, camera pose, printable objects, and articulated structures from sparse observations. Multi-view selection, monocular priors, differentiable rendering, and kinematic constraints improve scale, detail, and generalization across object categories.

topics.name: Dynamic Video, 4D, and Avatar Generation
topics.summary: Video and avatar generators coordinate camera paths, object motion, facial behavior, audio, and persistent identity over time. Geometry-aware controls, structured latent variables, and memory mechanisms improve temporal consistency in unconstrained or interactive scenes.

topics.name: Procedural Visual Content Generation
topics.summary: Agentic visual-production systems decompose scene creation into planning, coding, simulation, review, and reusable skill updates. Runtime inspection of graphs and generated outputs helps recover from failures and makes repeated Blender or node-based workflows more reliable.

topics.name: Efficient Vision Models and Compression
topics.summary: Vision models are compressed through distillation, wavelet or frequency interactions, binarization, token reduction, structural pruning, and capacity-aware adaptation. Results across transformers and edge settings show that preserving spatial relationships is central to useful efficiency.

topics.name: Collaborative Perception and Task-Oriented Communication
topics.summary: Collaborative perception systems transmit compact latent features, sparse geometry, or distilled representations instead of full sensor streams. Multi-agent experiments measure the tradeoff among bandwidth, latency, geometric fidelity, and downstream detection quality.

topics.name: Robust 3D Perception for Autonomous Systems
topics.summary: Autonomous 3D perception is evaluated under weather changes, moving objects, sensor degradation, and adversarial point perturbations. Radar conditioning, temporal stereo geometry, and attack-aware testing help preserve localization and scene understanding when normal assumptions fail.

topics.name: Camouflaged and Low-Visibility Object Detection
topics.summary: Detection models address camouflage and difficult illumination using frequency-aware representations and paired RGB-thermal observations. Experiments target unreliable appearance cues across fog, darkness, terrain variation, and visually confusing backgrounds.

topics.name: Underwater Computer Vision
topics.summary: Underwater vision methods model attenuation, depth-dependent blur, marine particles, and cluttered backgrounds for enhancement and salient-object detection. Realistic simulations and marine imagery are used to assess robustness beyond clean laboratory scenes.

topics.name: Remote Sensing and Satellite Vision
topics.summary: Satellite and aerial imagery pipelines adapt detectors to aircraft, schools, and connectivity infrastructure in complex backgrounds. Transfer learning, enhancement, and spatial proximity analysis support practical monitoring and planning applications.

topics.name: Physics-Informed Scientific Machine Learning
topics.summary: Scientific models combine neural operators, PDE residuals, physical dynamics, graph or frequency structure, and generated numerical code. Applications span field reconstruction, turbulent flow, neutron transport, spacecraft control, material modeling, and low-power scientific computation.

topics.name: Time-Series Forecasting and Dynamical Systems
topics.summary: Temporal models use Koopman structure, multiscale attention, state-space updates, fast weights, Fourier features, and adaptive memory for long or shifting sequences. Evaluations cover energy, weather, traffic, hydrology, telecom activity, equipment health, and simulated physical systems.

topics.name: Statistical Learning Theory and High-Dimensional Inference
topics.summary: Theoretical analyses study density-ratio estimation, incomplete-data clustering, model aggregation, and cross-validation risk. Asymptotic expansions and finite-sample arguments clarify when regularization or naive validation can distort uncertainty and performance comparisons.

topics.name: Model Evaluation, Uncertainty, and Conformal Prediction
topics.summary: Evaluation methods address estimator dependence, subgroup leakage, clustering validation, residual structure, censored outcomes, and policy-aware prediction sets. The recurring goal is calibrated evidence that remains useful under shifted data and operational decisions.

topics.name: Causal Modeling and Actual Causality
topics.summary: Causal systems combine fault-tree semantics, minimal-cause reasoning, retrieval, prior knowledge, and conditional-independence tests. The studies connect formal explanations of failure with interactive discovery of high-dimensional causal graphs.

topics.name: Online Allocation and Neuro-Symbolic Scheduling
topics.summary: Online decision methods derive regret guarantees for finite-capacity allocation near acceptance thresholds, including random consumption and degenerate regimes. Learned branching and dependency hints are paired with exact feasibility checks for large scheduling and constraint problems.

topics.name: Anomaly Detection with Limited Labels
topics.summary: Anomaly detectors combine visual-language features, wavelet transforms, statistical tests, and edge-oriented implementations when target labels are scarce. Benchmarks weigh detection quality against false alarms, computation, and deployment latency across visual and temporal data.

topics.name: AI-Assisted Electronic Design Automation
topics.summary: Electronic-design systems use retrieval, execution feedback, OCR, detectors, and vision-language reasoning to produce executable kernels or circuit netlists. Validation focuses on functional correctness, wire connectivity, performance, and robustness to schematic variation.

topics.name: Distributed and Low-Latency AI Systems
topics.summary: Deployment systems reduce interruption, communication, memory, queueing, and energy costs across distributed training and inference. Checkpoint recovery, sparse synchronization, streaming state control, model routing, and lightweight architectures are evaluated under realistic load and hardware limits.

topics.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Evidence Management
topics.summary: Retrieval systems select, compress, replay, and verify context from repositories, academic sources, media collections, and long inputs. Hybrid search, source-quality metadata, factual-break detection, and evidence-aware state updates improve grounded answers without indiscriminate context expansion.

topics.name: Agent Memory and Continual Knowledge Updating
topics.summary: Persistent memory systems separate current, historical, and changing facts while controlling knowledge edits, attention budgets, identity, and locality. Ledger checks, scoped low-rank updates, and reliance-preserving objectives reduce stale retrieval and unintended changes during continual adaptation.

topics.name: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation and Model Merging
topics.summary: Language-model adaptation treats expert capacity, weight geometry, activation patterns, and training examples as allocatable resources. Merging, pruning, low-rank growth, and neuron-guided selection improve specialization or transfer while limiting memory and annotation requirements.

topics.name: Domain-Specialized Language Model Post-Training
topics.summary: Specialized post-training is studied for manufacturing assistance, Turkish reasoning, calibrated uncertainty, and long-form domain knowledge. Sparse updates and carefully constructed supervision can improve local competence, but experiments reveal uneven transfer and possible loss of generality.

topics.name: Structured Knowledge and Output Evaluation
topics.summary: Language systems are assessed on nested records, relabeled graphs, ontology induction, relation extraction, and schema-constrained outputs. Structure-sensitive scores and repair hints reveal errors that token-level similarity or unconstrained generation can hide.

topics.name: LLM Evaluation and Process Supervision
topics.summary: Benchmarks, rubrics, expert anchors, prompt coresets, leakage checks, abstention gates, and process-level signals are used to assess model and agent quality. The combined evidence stresses domain validity, judge reliability, requirement coverage, and calibrated confidence over single aggregate scores.

topics.name: Library and Information Science Methods
topics.summary: Large-scale library and information science studies classify full-text research methods automatically and compare patterns across countries, topics, and demographic factors. The analyses separate subject effects from methodological preferences and track convergence over time.

topics.name: Speech Backdoor and Audio Data Poisoning
topics.summary: Speech recognizers are attacked with poisoned examples, steganographic signals, and covert timbre triggers. Experiments examine clean-label settings, multiple target behaviors, trigger concealment, and resistance to defensive filtering.

topics.name: Structure-Aware Learning for Omics and Molecules
topics.summary: Biological models incorporate pathway graphs, molecular substructures, chemical language representations, and descriptor branches rather than treating measurements as unrelated features. Attribution and uncertainty checks connect predictions to domain structure in microbiome and solubility tasks.

topics.name: Computational Neuroimaging
topics.summary: Neuroimaging infrastructure and multiscale EEG analyses organize heterogeneous brain data for behavioral and dimensional studies. The work emphasizes interoperable processing, feature design, and cautious interpretation when signals are weak or protocols differ.

topics.name: Wearable Physiological Sensing
topics.summary: Wearable motion and physiological streams are analyzed for tremor, sleep, activity, environment, affect, and cognition. Distribution-aware summaries and spectral features support inference from sparse labels and long everyday recordings.

topics.name: Quantum Algorithms Under Resource Constraints
topics.summary: Quantum studies examine coherent-memory limits, constraint-preserving mixers, hardware noise, and penalty selection. Theory and experiments show how architecture and resource choices influence algorithmic behavior beyond nominal problem size.

topics.name: Neural Media Compression and Semantic Communication
topics.summary: Learned representations reduce audio-visual storage and transmission costs through adaptive residual coding and quantized implicit networks. Evaluations compare quality, error recovery, bandwidth, and parameter budgets across wireless and multimedia settings.

topics.name: Language-Model Behavioral Measurement
topics.summary: Psychometric studies test whether human personality inventories and trait geometries meaningfully characterize language models. Results show strong prompt dependence, weak trait separation, and collapsed structures, motivating constructs tailored to observable model behavior.

topics.name: Federated Learning with Heterogeneous Data
topics.summary: Federated systems learn from clients with mismatched sensors, images, tasks, or noise while keeping raw records local. Personalized filtering, compact fusion, self-supervision, and robust aggregation address privacy, distribution shift, and unreliable participants.

topics.name: Language-Guided Decision Making
topics.summary: Language models act as selective advisors inside partially observed or changing control problems. Persistent state, uncertainty gates, and replanning policies determine when textual assistance is useful while leaving low-level execution to conventional decision mechanisms.

topics.name: Traffic Scene Understanding and Safety Prediction
topics.summary: Traffic models represent vehicles, pedestrians, kinematics, and changing relations with graph and temporal structures. Applications include maneuver forecasting and conflict detection, with scene-level objectives improving consistency across locations and interaction patterns.
